title: Cabin in the Forest
subtitle: I climbed the creaky wooden stairs to see the dusty treehouse.

items.text: A Nightmare at Green Lake
Living area of the Cabin

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: The lock has been broken. Those are bite marks from small critters. They might have nested inside.

items.speaker: Horropedia
items.text: This damn place has power supply? Who'll pay for the bill?

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Maybe it has underground cables, or it's powered by some generation sets left by Zeno. Wait, stop here.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: To your right, by the corner of the stairway, there are three ... no, at least three of them.

items.speaker: Horropedia
items.text: They are getting closer. Blondie, take your friends away.

items.speaker: Critter Crowd
items.text: Coo ...!

items.speaker: Blonney
items.text: Strange ... I remember I left it here. Where's the camera?

items.speaker: Anne
items.text: Are you looking for something? Perhaps I can help.

items.speaker: Blonney
items.text: No one asks for your help. Go away.
Blonney extends her arm and stops the girl.

items.speaker: Blonney
items.text: If you have nothing better to do, go clean the house up. I need a place to rest.

items.speaker: Anne
items.text: Yes, sure, you must be tired. Don't worry. I'll take care of it.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Let me give you a hand, Anne.

items.speaker: Anne
items.text: That'd be great. The tools are in the closet. This won't take us long.
The cleaning is finally done. Anne and Sonetto walk around in the living area, handing out blankets they found in the cabinet.
Michael sniffs, turning his eyes speculatively.

items.speaker: Michael
items.text: So, you guys are really the investigators from the St. Pavlov Foundation?

items.speaker: Anne
items.text: What is St. Pavlov Foundation?

items.speaker: Michael
items.text: No way! You've never heard about St. Pavlov Foundation?

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: St. Pavlov Foundation is an official institution that takes in and organizes arcanists, Anne.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: My friends and I work for them. We will try our best to keep everyone here safe.

items.speaker: Michael
items.text: I've never met a real one. What do you guys normally do? Taking humans for subject research? Roaming around to snoop on the political parties? Are those stories true?

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Human subject ... research? Political parties? Pardon me. I don't follow you.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: We will never do harm to any human. It's strictly stipulated.

items.speaker: Michael
items.text: Save your bureaucratic rhetoric, little girl!

items.speaker: Michael
items.text: I've read those books. I know you've done some dirty things. Tell me!

items.speaker: Blonney
items.text: Shut your face, Michael. I recruited you to play the Fool, not asking you to really be one!

items.speaker: Blonney
items.text: Don't bring disgrace on us for going to Vines State College with you.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: You are all students from Vines State College?

items.speaker: Blonney
items.text: Yes, Faculty of Filmmaking. This fool here is a chemistry student. The big guy over there is an art student on English literature and poetry.

items.speaker: Blonney
items.text: It's one of my assignments to make a movie during the semester break.

items.speaker: Blonney
items.text: So I hired every useless meathead available and traveled all the way to this s**thole, just to shoot a stupid horror movie.

items.speaker: Horropedia
items.text: Stupid horror movie?

items.speaker: Horropedia
items.text: I thought you loved horror movies.

items.speaker: Blonney
items.text: Eww! Don't disgust me!

items.speaker: Blonney
items.text: Who would possibly have interest in the movies filled with characters in sweat and dust and presenting zero romance or any nice costumes?!

items.speaker: Horropedia
items.text: You mean you are not interested in horror movies but determined to film one here?
Blonney pauses for a second, wrapping herself tighter in the blanket.

items.speaker: Blonney
items.text: You tell me. They are cliched, meaningless, but easy to make.

items.speaker: Blonney
items.text: They are the easiest option for this assignment. That's it. I've never liked any of them.

items.speaker: Horropedia
items.text: Oh, I see.

items.speaker: Horropedia
items.text: That's why you selected this awful script, all these beautiful but useless props, and such an untrained cast.

items.speaker: Blonney
items.text: Ah! What did you say?! Awful script?!

items.speaker: Horropedia
items.text: Well, I've read your script. It is illogical and dull. The conflicts are not strong enough.

items.speaker: Horropedia
items.text: Or we can call it classic, but, in another word, it's stale.

items.speaker: Horropedia
items.text: I really wonder, how did you get admitted to the filmmaking faculty? The admission criteria for Vines State College should be quite difficult to meet, hmm.

items.speaker: Blonney
items.text: You! What do you know about filmmaking? You're no one but a spawn of the Foundation, like those bodyguards my daddy has.

items.speaker: Jason
items.text: Come on, relax, Blonney.
Jason lifts one arm and rests it on the girl's shoulder.

items.speaker: Jason
items.text: If your dad didn't sponsor the two library buildings, you would not be here studying filmmaking.

items.speaker: Jason
items.text: And you look exactly like an arcanist when you get mad. Don't ... It's not a good look.

items.speaker: Blonney
items.text: F**king say that again? Think you can take a punch from me?

items.speaker: Blonney
items.text: I'm not in a good mood today. I just lost a camera, so you can keep on pissing me off if life has been too good for you!

items.speaker: Jason
items.text: Wow, wow, wow! Normally, you wouldn't be so mad over a little joke like this. Are you making a fuss now because your arcanist "friends" got your back?

items.speaker: Anne
items.text: Jason! Jennifer is trying to finish a project. You shouldn't be mean to her!

items.speaker: Anne
items.text: And Jennifer, please don't get into a fight with him. Isn't he your friend?

items.speaker: Anne
items.text: I thought friends won't say hurtful words to each other. I don't understand. Is this the way people make friends in the outside world?
Her words of mediation seem only inadequate and useless in front of Blonney's anger. The young girl jumps onto her classmate like a furious cat.
She pulls Jason's hair and ears, yelling in rage.

items.speaker: Blonney
items.text: I will knock off every tooth in your mouth and give them away to that crazy teeth collector.

items.speaker: Blonney
items.text: Only in this way can your empty head remember how much I hate being called an "arcanist"!
Angry scratches appear on the man's face, and he seems equally mad.

items.speaker: Jason
items.text: But you are always an arcanist. Although you've tried every means to be a human, it won't change your identity!
The Foundation's investigator does not plan to stand aside and watch.

items.speaker: Horropedia
items.text: However much you despise us, many brilliant playwrights are arcanists.

items.speaker: Anne
items.text: Mr. Horropedia, please stop making this worse.

items.speaker: Blonney
items.text: You jerk!

items.speaker: Tooth Fairy
items.text: Quiet.
As Tooth Fairy knocks on the table with her glass jar, the sparkling creatures inside are frightened and start to hit the jar.

items.speaker: Tooth Fairy
items.text: If you don't shut up now, I will shut you all up forever.

items.speaker: Tooth Fairy
items.text: Ms. Anne has a point. This is not how friends get along.

items.speaker: Tooth Fairy
items.text: Ladies and gentlemen, we are not here to fight. We need to cooperate.

items.speaker: Tooth Fairy
items.text: I don't expect you to love each other, but no more fights. I don't care whether you are arcanist or human.

items.speaker: Tooth Fairy
items.text: Now, sit back on the sofa, everyone.

items.speaker: Horropedia
items.text: I'm sorry, Ms. Tooth Fairy.

items.speaker: Anne
items.text: I'm sorry too. I should have stopped them.

items.speaker: Jason
items.text: Humph!
The young people sit back on the couch. There is a strange, uncomfortable silence in the room.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Blonney, is Anne also recruited as an actress? She is not as restless ... energetic as your classmates.

items.speaker: Blonney
items.text: No, she isn't. She is a local villager. We met by the edge of the woods.

items.speaker: Blonney
items.text: As well as Rod, the one that plays the Butcher. That's everyone in my crew. Now, if your curiosity has been well satisfied, leave. I need a break!
Freddie, who is hiding in the corner, suddenly talks to Blonney in a low voice.

items.speaker: Freddie
items.text: Sorry to interrupt you when you are not in a good mood. Actually, Rod didn't come here. He's hospitalized. Do you remember?

items.speaker: Blonney
items.text: He's not here? Then who played the Butcher?

items.speaker: Freddie
items.text: Isn't he another actor you hired? Together with Anne, in the town near the woods.

items.speaker: Blonney
items.text: No, I've never looked for any other actors!

items.speaker: Blonney
items.text: The only new actor I hired is Anne, because she looks almost like a twin to Anna, and Anna is absent because of her stomach flu.

items.speaker: Blonney
items.text: Oh, wait. Right, Anna is in hospital because of her stomach flu, which was a result of that toad bark stew she had with Rod. So Rod, Rod was not in the car with us when we left.

items.speaker: Freddie
items.text: Holy Mother of God.

items.speaker: Blonney
items.text: That ... that is, we've been with a "butcher" whose identity is unknown to all of us ...

items.speaker: Blonney
items.text: Ahhh!

items.speaker: Anne
items.text: Jennifer, don't worry. I will protect you!

items.speaker: Blonney
items.text: How is this possible! When did this place get so dark! What time is it now? Hey! Freddie, stop whining and take a look at the clock!

items.speaker: Freddie
items.text: Okay, okay. Afternoon, afternoon, 1 p.m.
Outside the window, there is midnight darkness. Nobody notices when the sun is gone.
Freddie looks up. His lips are shaking. His face turns pale and twists strangely.

items.speaker: Freddie
items.text: Is that Ro- ... nope, that butcher? He is going to slaughter us. He is truly a cold-blooded murderer!

items.speaker: Jason
items.text: Don't freak out, Freddie. A murderer is not someone you frequently meet. We are not shooting a horror movie.

items.speaker: Horropedia
items.text: Actually, you are.

items.speaker: Horropedia
items.text: A giant monster, a fake friend of yours, a sudden nightfall … Anything here not like a horror movie?

items.speaker: Jason
items.text: Damn it! Aren't you being paranoid enough? Do you want the situation to get messier?

items.speaker: Jason
items.text: You! Sit down! I will go check the electrical panel and fix it. It will bring back the light and restore your sanity.

items.speaker: Horropedia
items.text: Hmm. Negative from me.

items.speaker: Horropedia
items.text: Those who remain alone in a horror movie never end up safe and sound. If the butcher is really lingering outside the door, you will be his "first blood."

items.speaker: Horropedia
items.text: Although you are rude, impolite, and suspected to ancestry discrimination, I suggest you to take someone with you for the sake of your safety.

items.speaker: Jason
items.text: Back off, you troll!
Jason walks out of the cabin in anger. The wooden door is forcefully shut behind him.
The rest of them look at each other. Suddenly, Horropedia gasps and rubs his shoulder. It's aching due to the push just now.

items.speaker: Horropedia
items.text: He really didn't do that on purpose, did he?

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: What on purpose?

items.speaker: Horropedia
items.text: He said and did all the things you shouldn't be doing.

items.speaker: Horropedia
items.text: We are in a horror movie. His actions are like taking some sleeping pills, putting the noose around his neck, and shooting himself in the head.
